sections.description: Mimam's Var - WP is a modular design-system operating layer inside WordPress. Centralize your CSS variables, manage theme scales, configure fluid scales, build layout utility structures, and sync seamlessly with Figma.
sections.changelog:
v1.3.116 - Dev

  • Fixed Nestable and Layout Element Bulk Tag Matching: Added full support for customTag and _customTag setting fields inside BricksAdapter.getElementTagName. Previously, when a user set a custom tag override on a Div/Block element to 'li', the settings only stored '_tag: custom' and '_customTag: li'. Since _customTag was completely missing from the settings candidates list, it fell back to 'div', causing tag-targeted bulk commands (e.g. 'all li => ...') to skip matching these overridden elements. This has been resolved, enabling all custom-tagged elements to match bulk commands correctly.
  • Fixed Active Component/Template Element List Support: Updated getMutableElementsRoot to support active component/template element lists. If a user is active inside a Bricks component/template, the elements array resides in state.activeComponent.elements instead of globals.$_dynamicElements.value. Adding this check enables Mimam's Bar to successfully locate, target, and bulk-modify elements inside component editor screens.

v1.3.115 - Dev

  • Fixed Global Admin Floating Launcher Icon (FAB) Visibility: Reverted the restrictive enqueue guard in AdminAdapter.php. The settings panel asset (builder-panel.js) is now loaded globally across all WordPress Admin screens again, restoring the bottom-right floating gear launcher button (speed dial FAB) as expected by the user.
  • Fixed Keyboard Shortcut/Keybind Hijacking: Added element input guards to Alt+Z (builder-panel.js) and matchesShortcut/Alt+Q (global-event-manager.js) keydown listeners.
  • Fixed Bricks Save State for Bulk Operations: Overwriting element.settings directly with the nextSettings clone now fires Vue's Proxy setter hooks correctly. Additionally, bulk commits now push 'components' into Bricks' native state.unsavedChanges array, activating the Bricks Save button.
